tagline: A native Mac terminal for AI coding agents, with an iPhone remote.
description: Run Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Copilot CLI in real terminal sessions on your Mac, and pick the same sessions up from your iPhone by scanning a QR code.
overview: AgentTerm is a terminal built around coding agents. One click starts Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or Copilot CLI in a project folder. Next to the terminal you have the folder's git changes to stage and commit, the conversations each agent had there to resume or hand off to another agent, a file browser with an editor, and a band that shows the model, how full its context is and what your account has left before its limits reset.

Sessions are held by a small host on the Mac, so they keep running when the window is closed. Pair an iPhone by scanning a QR code and the same sessions open there over your own Tailscale network: the terminal resizes to the phone, a key bar gives you Esc, Tab and the arrows, and a compose field takes prompts from the normal iOS keyboard, Vietnamese included. The Mac app is open source.
